prediction.limitations: 15k metrics are recomputed from fixed supplied predictions; replay only the intersection with the 100k corpus using raw title+body and service preprocessing. Training-time inputs/full split are not available in this ZIP. No retraining or threshold selection on the test set.

latency.method: Sequential Python service wall-clock seconds, excluding browser rendering and network. Warm = one untimed call per scenario; cold = new Python process incl service imports/cache load, OS cache not flushed. P95 nearest rank; small sample not production load/SLA.

cost.note: Offline extractive/BM25/sklearn/SQL only, no paid request. Latency repeats and model replay are also local. CPU/RAM/storage/electricity not included. API model price must be supplied for a live run; no guessed rate.
